table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	saleledger.saleinvcode , 
	saleledger.salecatcode , 
	saleledger.date , 
	saleledger.custrefno , 
	saleledger.remarks , 
	saleledger.custcode , 
	saleledger.salesmancode ,
	saleledger.headerno,  
	users.username , 
	saleledger.discperc , 
	saleledger.flatdisc , 
	saleledger.misccharges , 
	saleledger.salestax , 
	saleledger.posted , 
	saleledger.postdate , 
	customer.address1 , 
	customer.city , 
	customer.phone ,
	customerbalance = 0,
	debitorcredit = ' ',
	aliasname=accounts.aliasname,
	saleledger.headerinvno,
	saleledger.originaldate,
	saleledger.modifiedby,
	saleledger.sprice,
	saleledger.quotationno,
	saleledger.postedby,
	saleledger.doctcode,
	patientRegNo=patient.regno,
	saleledger.patientcode,
	patientbalance=0.00,
	cashreceived,
	invGSTPerc1=saleledger.InvGstPerc1,
	dd_gstperc=0,
	gcode=0,
	saleledger.gstno,
	saleledger.PrintWaranty,
	saleledger.PrintBatch,
	saleledger.MessageCode,
	Message.Description,
	saleledger.SmanCode,
	Salesman.Name,
	saleledger.custrefno2,
	saleledger.custrefno3,
	saleledger.custrefno4,
	saleledger.InvoiceSize,
	saleledger.invtotal,
	saleledger.machinename,
	saleledger.ModifyCounter,
	saleledger.wardcode,
	saleledger.diseasecode,
	saleledger.relationcode,
	Saleledger.itemdiscpercno,
	Saleledger.AdmissionCode,
	Saleledger.AccountFor,
	Saleledger.PaymentMode,
	Saleledger.PaymentAccCode,
	Saleledger.Amt,
	Saleledger.AmtBy,
	Saleledger.AmtDate,
	Saleledger.AmtReference,
	saleledger.Outstandingamt,
	saleledger.marked,
	saleledger.prescode,
	saleledger.salecomments1,
	saleledger.salecomments2,
	patientadmission.locationcode,
	saleledger.custrefno5,
	saleledger.CashTendered,
	saleledger.CashCharged,
	saleledger.CashBack,
	saleledger.cashacccode

FROM  
	saleledger 
	LEFT OUTER JOIN Salesman ON (saleledger.smancode = salesman.salesmancode)
	LEFT OUTER JOIN Message ON (saleledger.messagecode = message.messagecode),
	customer , 
	users , 
	accounts ,
	patientadmission,
	patient	

WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ar_SaleInvCode )   and
	( saleledger.admissioncode = patientadmission.admissioncode ) and
	( patientadmission.patientcode = patient.patientcode ) and
	( saleledger.custcode = customer.custcode ) and 
	( users.usercode = saleledger.salesmancode ) and 
	( customer.custcode = accounts.acccode )
